response.original_title: Joey B Toonz: Get a Load of This!
response.overview: Join Joey B Toonz, self-proclaimed "idiocracy historian", as he dives headfirst into the world of social media obsession. Armed with a microphone and a genuine concern for society, Joey treats humanity’s online existence as a case study in why aliens refuse to communicate with us. Every clip is dissected with his signature sarcastic commentary and rapid-fire humor.  This collection features Joey's earliest commentary videos, documenting his first discovery of TikTok and the bizarre world of selfie culture, "influencer" narcissism, and humanity's relentless pursuit of internet fame.  Featuring nearly ninety minutes of classic Joey B Toonz videos, this collector's edition also includes never-before-seen bonus videos, videos banned from YouTube, and other exclusive content you won't find anywhere else.
